feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 4 June 2026 6:18am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

SW or W-SW veering W, 5 or 6, but occasionally 6 to 7 in places, decreasing 4 or 5 late in the night.


##State of sea)##

Moderate, occasionally rough at first, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather)##

Showers, becoming isolated later today, then fair overnight.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 15°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong wind late in the night.


##Wind)##

W 4 or 5, backing South, then SE 5 overnight, occasionally 6 later.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather)##

Mainly fair, then rain arriving at night & into Saturday morning.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 14°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C

##Warnings)##

Strong wind.

##State of sea)##

Moderate, occasionally rough for a time, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather)##

Rain, becoming mainly fair by late afternoon.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.


##Temperature##

##Weather)##

Mostly fair at first, isolated showers during afternoon, then rain developing evening / night.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor later.
